Original photographic reconstruction; city query has no interior bailey height point

attribution: Elevation observations: City of Turku, CC-BY4.0, retrieved2026-10-09.
limitations: This is an original interpolation of27 city height points and contour segments, not a downloaded DTM or terrain survey. The8.572m inner-court point is measured; second upper court is reconstructed level with it. Bailey4m and between-observation rock/grade shape are reconstructed. Use compatible N2000 host terrain; sparse interpolation cannot certify doors, ramps, buried foundations or current harbour works.
